summary: Pool Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its receivables purchase agreement (securitization facility). The amendment extends the facility termination date to August 25, 2028 and increases the maximum facility limit to $400 million ($300 million committed, $100 million uncommitted) during March–September, with $300 million ($200 million committed, $100 million uncommitted) for other months. Interest is based on one-month Term SOFR plus a margin of 0.75% or 0.85%, depending on tranche. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, with no change of control, strategic action, or capital event.
